description: tldrx v0 — all hooks wired, all INERT. Every handler reads stdin, logs to stderr and exits 0 (allow). Shape verified from https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks.md: top-level `hooks` map keyed by event name, each entry { matcher?, hooks: [ { type, command, args?, timeout? } ] }. Exec form (`command` + `args`) and the ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} variable are both from that page. NOTE: the status line is NOT a hook event — it is the `statusLine` settings key, and a plugin settings.json only supports `agent` and `subagentStatusLine`. Wire it yourself; see plugin/README.md.

PostToolUse._note: claim-sources — concept §8: every Findings/Decisions bullet in tldrx-work/**/*.md must carry [src: …].
dod-gate — concept §8: a story is done only when this hook re-ran its command block with exit 0.

PreToolUse._note: no-reask — concept §1.2: reject a question whose subject already exists in memory/facts.yml.

budget-gate — concept §8: refuse a stage the run cannot afford; cap each sub-agent. TODO(verify): `Task` is the tool name the docs pages fetched for this skeleton never spell out for subagent spawns; confirm against the tools reference before this hook is allowed to block.

UserPromptSubmit._note: answer-capture — concept §2/§13: capture interview answers to memory/facts.yml with provenance. UserPromptSubmit does not support a `matcher` (verified in the hooks event table).

SessionStart._note: session-start — concept §3: print one 'where we are' line. Matcher omitted so it fires for every start reason (startup, resume, clear, compact, fork).
